title: Rafter spans.
officialText:
Allowable spans for rafters shall be in accordance with Table 2308.10.3(1), 2308.10.3(2),
2308.10.3(3), 2308.10.3(4), 2308.10.3(5) or 2308.10.3(6). For other grades and species, refer to the AF&PA Span
Tables for Joists and Rafters.
